title: Soft Glam vs. Full Glam: Finding Your Perfect Bridal Look
excerpt: Choosing between soft glam and full glam sets the entire tone for your wedding day beauty — here's how to decide.
content: Soft glam embraces luminous skin, subtle definition, and a romantic warmth that photographs beautifully in natural Florida light. Full glam, on the other hand, delivers bold lashes, dramatic contour, and rich color that commands attention from every angle. The right choice depends on your venue, your gown, and most importantly, how you want to feel when you see yourself in the mirror.
